title: bug: CBOR skip loop DoS on malformed keystore input
description: cbor_skip() in wp11_keystore.c guards against SIZE_MAX overflow with if (val > SIZE_MAX/2) but does not bound the loop iteration count independently. A crafted .p11k file with a CBOR map header claiming 2^62 pairs passes the overflow check (2^62 < 2^63) and causes O(2^62) iterations before the per-iteration buffer-exhaustion check fires. Parsing a single malicious byte sequence locks the process. Fix: add a secondary bound: if (val > reasonable_max) return WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_CBOR, where reasonable_max is e.g. WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_KEYS * 2.
